FT-046.adaptation: Rev 3 accepted: verify all 16 session ACKs and rebalance only within approved exclusive lanes. VERIFICATION RESULT: 0 of 16 lanes had published a structured ack record after round 1. They wrote markdown handoffs only, which the tooling does not read, so sixteen completed lanes were invisible to the Commander for the same reason this supervisor's report was until its schema was repaired. Every round-2 lane brief now carries the exact required key list; 4 have published valid records so far (daniel-title, daniel-color, daniel-images, daniel-spelling). NO REBALANCING PERFORMED: lane ownership is unchanged, exclusive and one crate each. ATTRIBUTION DEFECT FOUND AND FIXED: daniel-images committed two Claude-Session trailers, which the machine owner's standing rule forbids anywhere in Git. All 17 branches were audited; only that one was affected. The trailers were stripped with byte-identical trees, author and Co-authored-by preserved, and the branch force-pushed while still unmerged with nothing depending on it. Two further lanes hit the same pressure: daniel-spelling caught and corrected it itself before committing, and daniel-contents deliberately emitted both trailers and said so openly rather than resolving the conflict silently, which was the right disclosure even though the wrong resolution. Three of sixteen lanes affected in total; all fixed before or immediately after publication, with byte-identical trees. The pressure is systemic: an environment reminder instructs agents to add that trailer and it conflicts with the owner's rule, so every lane brief now states the prohibition explicitly. ROUND 2 RESULT: 15 of 16 lanes complete and published with valid ack records, closing the ACK gap rev 3 identified. FT-030 paragraph-layout rev 3 remains unstarted because this machine's tool-permission layer refused to launch it; this is the local permission blocker rev 2 and rev 3 both asked to be reported, and it is not a quota or capacity limit. INTEGRATION CONFIRMED: the three transfer lanes are now ancestors of origin/main, so math-layout, paragraph-layout and font-engine work from this machine is merged. The 13 new crates are not yet on main. One lane, daniel-footnotes rev 3, returned with a security warning attached to its output. Its committed result was audited before publication: three files, all inside owned paths, additions only, no process, network, filesystem, env or unsafe usage, no secrets, 38 tests passing, clippy clean. The blocked action produced no artifact. Published on that basis.
